environment.profiles: fresh independent profiles on one physical machine

metric: Canonical guest media timeline error relative to the host anchor, evaluated at the guest observation timestamp; not acoustic output latency
transient_sampling: Approximately one second apart; guest deliberately sought backward by 250ms; buffering briefly increased the error
settled_sampling: Later samples, approximately 0.5 seconds apart; rounded to nearest millisecond; intervening samples not recorded

automatic_join_trial.result: Guest joined and automatically sought to the host timeline; no manual alignment

limits: One local demonstration, not a statistical performance study
No WAN, packet-loss, load, long-duration or acoustic latency benchmark
Rounded settled values do not imply zero jitter
